acceptance_predicates.description: TUI displays channel, repository, resolved commit, source/build digest, and development-only status from the ASB manifest.
Stale, malformed, mismatched, and unavailable manifests render typed recovery guidance.
TUI consumes rather than duplicates ASB resolver authority.

definition_of_done: Exact paired heads and redacted fixtures pass.
Independent review accepts provenance and nonblocking warnings.

inputs.description: Versioned ASB channel manifest and hostile fixtures.

gates.description: TUI provenance and recovery views agree with ASB manifest semantics.
